verdict.rationale: Plausible offers a Stats API for querying its own data and CSV import/export, but there is no evidence of syncing events with an external data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery/Snowflake export, warehouse-native querying, or continuous export pipelines). Missing for 10: warehouse export/sync integration, in-product warehouse querying, any connector to BigQuery/Snowflake/Redshift.
